__baseline_prompt__.text: A natural photographic scene of a woman using wearable mechanical assistance in a small fabrication workshop, with readable mechanical connections and visible body-side ownership and contact. Use the supplied reference for her visible facial appearance and dark bob haircut. She has paused at a bench clamp, holding its lever against the lower stop with her left palm; her steady attention and relaxed mouth give the working moment a quiet personal presence. Her anatomical left arm is the near arm on image-right. An open shoulder yoke has its exposed root at the front outer edge of her left shoulder. From that root a continuous external support runs visibly through the shoulder pivot, upper-arm rail, elbow hinge, forearm rail and wrist cuff. The rail stands away from the plain charcoal work shirt, leaving daylight gaps between metal and torso. Her left elbow is mildly bent and held clear of her ribs, with the whole support route facing the camera. The left palm lies across the broad lever handle; the palm edge touching its top surface, thumb beside the handle and handle entering the clamp are visible together. Her other hand hangs freely on image-left. The camera sees her from slightly in front of her left side, framed from head to mid-thigh with space around the entire shoulder-to-handle route. Broad window light models her face and gives each metal connection an edged highlight against a subdued workshop background. The face, linked arm support and hand contact carry the photograph together, with natural skin texture and restrained metallic reflections.
